title: Provenance-led golden collection retention & re-curation workflow
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and implement a provenance-first lifecycle for golden prompt/response collections that ties retention, re-curation, and access controls to model and config changes. Goals: (1) ensure every golden sample has immutable provenance metadata (model version, config hash, creator, steward signatures, eval-run id); (2) define retention tiers (hot reviewable, cold archive) and automated expiration rules; (3) create a re-curation pipeline that triggers when model/config deltas exceed configurable thresholds and surfaces affected samples to stewards; (4) enforce ACLs and reviewer approval before any golden is marked as canonical for gating; (5) integrate with CI and the eval sentinel so regressions triggered by config/model changes automatically open workstreams and optionally mark affected golden sets for review or quarantine.
progress_updates: 2025-11-06: Kickoff with PM and two stewards. Aligned on per-sample provenance metadata fields and retention tiers.
2025-11-12: Spike completed for config delta detection using hash + weighted config diffs. Prototype script lives in infra/eval-tools (PR #187).
2025-11-20: Security reviewed ACL model; requested KMS-backed signing for steward approvals. Follow-up task created.
2025-11-28: End-to-end prototype run: detected regression between runtime-1.20 and runtime-1.22 for a small anchor corpus; re-curation pipeline queued 42 samples for steward review.
2025-12-02: Design doc updated with storage tiering and cost estimates; opened feature branch for API and DB schema changes (PR #214).
acceptance_criteria: All golden items include immutable provenance fields at creation: model_id, model_commit, config_hash, created_by, steward_signatures, eval_run_id
Rules engine enforces retention tiers and can transition items between hot and cold with audit trail
Re-curation pipeline triggers automatically when a model/config change metric crosses threshold and surfaces prioritized review queue
ACLs prevent non-stewards from promoting or deleting canonical goldens; steward approvals are cryptographically signed (KMS/HSM-backed)
CI integration: a config/model change in a PR will surface affected golden sets and block merges if regression severity >= configured gating level
E2E test coverage for creation -> provenance recorded, re-curation trigger, steward sign-off, and rollback flow
risks: Dataset bloat: frequent model churn could create large numbers of quarantined samples
False positives: noisy delta detection leading to unnecessary steward work
Storage cost: long retention of many versions across customers
Permission mistakes: inadvertent exposure if ACLs misconfigured
mitigations: Retention policy with automated TTL and periodic sampling to compress low-value historical items
Tune delta thresholds and add signal filters (e.g., per-task variance, human-in-the-loop verification before quarantine)
Introduce a cold-tier blob store for archived goldens and fingerprints in the DB to avoid full duplication
Add RBAC matrix review in security checklist and implement a safe-mode that requires 2-person steward approvals for bulk mutations

notes: This ticket scopes the infra + workflow required to make golden set management resilient to frequent model/config churn. Follow-on tickets will implement UI review flows in Console, steward rotation tooling, and per-customer retention overrides.
